Why do I have different stats?
Units in this game use a randomized system, where stats like damage are randomly rolled with about a 10% variance (like Dungeon Quest items). When you evolve a unit they also reroll their stats, but it will always be strictly better than the pre-evolved version.

Selling

Units sell for 25% of their deployment cost and upgrades.

Trivia

  • Each time Switchblade (Deception) attacks, there is a chance to apply Dismember, making enemies take 25% more Physical damage. He is the second unit to have this, the first being Cursed King.
  • Switchblade and Switchblade (Deception) are the third and fourth units in the game who do 100% more damage when they attack with their critical hit, the first and second being Lex and Lex Akoman.
  • At max upgrade, he will deal an average damage per second ( Average DPS ) of 73,423.34, which includes both his base damage and the additional average damage his crit will add. His total group DPS ( TDPS ) will be 220,270.02. However, if you have the Endless Blades relic equipped and if that relic provides an additional 50% crit chance, then his DPS will increase to 97,897.79, raising his total group DPS to 293,693.36. (excluding the 25% physical damage buff from his dismember)
